newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guoco mandates $180 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Guoco mandates $180 mln credit facility.

text.p: Guoco Group has mandated NatWest Markets and Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi to arrange a US$180 million multi-currency revolving credit facility, coordinating arranger and bookrunner NatWest Markets said on Wednesday.
The facility has a final maturity of five years and pays a margin of 52.5 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
It is available in U.S. dollars, Japanese yen, German marks and British pounds.
Repayment of the facility will be in bullet form.
Proceeds will be used for refinancing a US$168 million facility arranged in 1995 and for general corporate purposes.
The facility has been fully underwritten by the coordinating arrangers NatWest Markets and Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi.
An arrangers group is being formed.
